SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody dread and sustained terror; to be the lingering fear that precedes and follows battle.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: Dread that lingers, the anticipation of horror, sustained terror.

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Propitiated alongside Phobos; invoked in war; represented sustained terror of conflict.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient war deity; Mars's moon named after him; represents prolonged fear vs sudden panic.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as dark presence accompanying Ares; personified dread and the anticipation of horror.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Deimos, dread that haunts before and after battle, shadow that never leaves the warrior.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A shadow that follows you, whispering of horrors yet to come

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Shadow work with chronic fear and anxiety; understanding sustained terror responses.
AIPromptSeeds: The god of dread whose name marks Mars's smaller moon.
Terror that lingers after battle ends.
